_comment: Mutation-score floors (#532). Up-only under test:ratchet. Seeded ~2–3pt below measured Stryker on property-defended mutate sets (2026-07-23/24): vault custody 100%; client intents+payload-hash ~73.5%; automation scheduler ~82%; blob-format CBSF 100%; protocol judge ~76.3%; tunnel pure wire ~81.5%; app-engine cost formula 100%. Re-seeded 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 1C): backup 97.09% measured locally after the WAL-addressing + seal/derive mutation-kill campaign (was 46.07%, below _absoluteWeaknessBelow); gateway allowed-hosts 78.79% and agent-runtime low-priority 91.89% taken from the last green nightly mutation lane (e2e.yml run 30524995032, 2026-07-30T08:10Z), replacing the conservative #545 D6 placeholders. Ratcheted 2026-07-31 (#656 Layer 3) to (measured − 2/3) against that same nightly run: protocol 85.71 → 83, tunnel 81.48 → 79, automation 83.84 → 81, client-replica 74.14 → 72. vault / blob-format / app-engine measured 100 and their 97 floors are already (measured − 3), so they are unchanged. #656 CORRECTION (2026-07-31, PR #661 CI run 30616999454): packages/backup and packages/blueprints were first seeded from LOCAL Stryker runs (97.09 and 88.52) and CI measured 85.47 and 77.46 — an ~11pt gap in both. Local darwin/arm64 and CI linux/x64 do not agree on these two mutate sets, so the floor is re-seeded ~3pt under the CI number, because CI is the lane that enforces it. Seeding from the developer's own machine is precisely the author-asserted claim this issue exists to eliminate.
